questions.passage: Kagan’s idea of “diluted emotion” is not exactly the same as Marx’s idea of alienation; Marx’s alienation is much darker. Also, being part of a big team and performing a specialized task such as data analysis is perhaps not as alienating as working in a factory assembly line. It can be fun to be part of something larger than yourself. After reading Kohn’s study, I was curious about the psychological consequences of the division of labor, specifically its effects on happiness, meaning, and psychological richness.
questions.prompt: What qualification does the author make before introducing the new research interest?
options: Kagan and Marx describe exactly the same degree of alienation.
All specialized teamwork is as alienating as an assembly line.
Being part of a larger team can never be enjoyable.
Specialized teamwork may be less alienating, and participating in a larger effort can be fun.
questions.promptZh: 引入新的研究兴趣前，作者作了什么限定？
optionsZh: Kagan 与 Marx 描述的异化程度完全相同。
所有专业团队工作都与流水线一样令人异化。
参与更大的团队绝不可能有乐趣。
专业团队工作也许较少令人异化，参与更大的事业也可能有趣。
analyses: A not exactly the same 和 much darker 表明二者有区别。
B perhaps not as alienating 保留程度差别，而非一概相等。
C can be fun 明确允许有趣。
D 同时保留 perhaps 的谨慎比较与 can 的可能性。作者在限定前述批评后提出研究兴趣，没有先宣布新研究的结果。

evidence.quote: perhaps not as alienating as working in a factory assembly line.
It can be fun to be part of something larger than yourself.

vocabulary.meaning: 令人疏离的；使人产生异化感的
vocabulary.context: 比较不同工作形式带来的疏离体验，原文用 perhaps 保留不确定性
vocabulary.example: The repetitive process felt alienating to some members of the team.

questions.translation: Kagan 所说的“情绪被稀释”与 Marx 的异化概念并不完全相同；Marx 的异化要阴暗得多。而且，作为大团队的一员，做数据分析这样的专门任务，也许不像在工厂流水线上工作那样令人异化。参与比自身更大的事业也可能很有趣。读了 Kohn 的研究后，我对劳动分工的心理后果产生了好奇，具体是它对幸福、意义和心理丰富性的影响。
